## What changed

In plain English: what the owner will notice, or "nothing visible" for
behind-the-scenes work. Link the Linear issue. Write `Fixes BZE-xx` only if this
pull request finishes that issue.

## How to see it

Preview link or screenshots (1280×720 and phone width for visible changes).

## Checks

- Tests run and results:
- Checks skipped and why (skipped checks are never reported as passed):
- Second review (required for money, trade or signing legality, saved data,
  permissions or security): reviewer and verdict, or "not needed" and why:

## Anything the owner needs to decide

None, or a short plain-English list.
